qualifications: Only 64 rollouts entered the two updates; the native stream also includes completed rollouts excluded by the training pipeline.
The saved episode graph supplies sampled token IDs and log probabilities directly; no assistant text was retokenized for these checks.
No independent raw HTTP token capture was made during this run; checks cover graph-to-training-sample identity, token usage, masking and finite log probabilities.
The first setup attempt was interrupted after a final-broadcast queue-drain deadlock. The patched second attempt completed the same two-update path and saved its terminal checkpoint.
The final synchronization barrier remains after the main loop drains; the patch removes only the premature barrier within final-batch processing.
Displayed trainer metrics are rounded console values, not replacements for the full-precision native metrics stream.
Native MFU exceeded 100 percent on step 2; that estimate is not treated as a measured hardware utilization result.
Setup-check adapters are diagnostic only. The full experiment starts with a new adapter on the preserved SFT checkpoint.
